content:
“Watch out for flying eyeballs!”— Perk card description

**Bloody Mess** is a Luck-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

The perk grants a chance for bleeding enemies that get killed to explode. The chance is higher the more Luck the player character has, and the damage of the explosion scales with their level.

There is also a very small chance for enemies to explode without the perk being equipped, which is also determined by Luck.

| Rank | Description | Form ID | 
| 1 | Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to explode based on your LCK. | 0004A0BB | 

- Prior to Patch 1.7.21.25, the perk had three ranks that granted 5%/10%/15% bonus damage and gave killed enemies a chance to explode into a gory red paste.
- Players, Robots, Scorchbeasts, and the Scorchbeast Queen cannot be exploded by this perk.
- This perk's gore effect is overridden by the Confetti Mess lunchbox perk.

- The perk used to be available in the Nuclear Winter battle royale gameplay mode, where it provided 15% bonus damage and gave killed enemies a chance to explode into a gory red paste. Equipping it cost nine points of Luck. [1] 
- An unused lifetime challenge would have required to equip the third rank of this perk. [2]
